principle: Plan against normalized capabilities, execute through the active MCP server, and ingest observed outputs back into evidence records.

server_families.description: CDP-style browser control and debugging servers.

Reverse-engineering-specific browser MCP servers with agent-first CDP debugging: silent/stealth navigation modes, optional source-level fingerprint patches, and takeover of an already-running browser (--browserUrl).
typical_strengths: set_breakpoint_on_text: text-located breakpoints inside minified code
break_on_xhr: XHR/fetch URL breakpoints with get_paused_info call stack + scoped variables
trace_function: non-pausing logpoint tracing into webpack-packed internals
inject_before_load / preload hooks for bootstrap-time signers
save_script_source: large/WASM script spillover to disk for offline analysis
anti-detection: protocol-level Patchright + optional source-level CloakBrowser
deobfuscation helpers (Babel fast path + webcrack deep mode on Pro forks)
server_families.pairing_note: When this family is present, prefer its execution surface for live capture; keep js-reverse-ops for methodology (stage gates, misdiagnosis triage), verification (stable-total rule), and delivery scaffolding. The built-in scripts/cdp_minibrowser.js remains the zero-dependency fallback when no MCP is installed. VALIDATED 2026-09 (v4.0.5, live target): page control, in-page evaluate (requires confirm:true; function-literal form), network capture of token-bearing requests, and break_on_xhr all work; stealth navigation may itself be fingerprinted by VM shells (see misdiagnosis M8) — prefer in-page triggers under stealth sessions.

server_families.description: Playwright-style browser MCP servers focused on deterministic browser automation with request observation and runtime evaluation.
Browser-tools MCP servers that expose tab, console, network, and debugger-style browser inspection.
Automation-first browser MCP servers that can still provide useful runtime truth.
Knowledge-base MCP servers that accumulate per-target parameter blueprints (verified pure-Node reproduction scripts for real-world anti-bot parameters).
typical_strengths: per-parameter pure-Node reproduction scripts (harness + patched env, no browser at replay time)
blueprint knowledge base keyed by target parameter family
server_families.pairing_note: The blueprint pattern maps onto js-reverse-ops case notes + pattern-outcome telemetry: record each solved parameter as a sanitized blueprint entry and let ranking evolve from solve telemetry.
